title: LeadDev 2026: engineering leadership
description: Four findings from the LeadDev Engineering Leadership Report 2026 on the light register, no logo, over a bright office photo (a laptop with a red warning, a code tile): 84% big at the top with “harder” on the red brush stroke, then 37%, 1 in 3 and 41% in three white cards with red pills.
source: LeadDev Engineering Leadership Report 2026. Figures and wording from the brief (Nov 2026). Background: generated with ElevenLabs (gpt-image-2.5-sunburst, 4:5, 2K), assets/background.jpg.
